title: Tree
summary: An expandable hierarchy of tree items with roving focus, single selection and type-ahead, following the WAI-ARIA tree pattern.

props.name: value
props.description: The value (or label) of the selected item.

events.name: pk-select
events.description: An item was chosen (bubbles from the item).

events.name: pk-toggle
events.description: A branch opened or closed (bubbles from the item).

methods.name: flattenTree(nodes)
methods.description: Visible nodes with level and parent.

a11y: role=tree with treeitem, aria-expanded, aria-selected, aria-level, aria-setsize and aria-posinset. One tab stop; arrows and Home and End move; Right and Left expand and collapse or move to the child or parent; Enter and Space select; typing a letter jumps to the next label starting with it.

examples.title: Categories
examples.html:
<pk-tree label="Categories">
  <pk-tree-item label="Books" expanded>
    <pk-tree-item label="Green"></pk-tree-item>
    <pk-tree-item label="DC"></pk-tree-item>
  </pk-tree-item>
  <pk-tree-item label="Cards"></pk-tree-item>
</pk-tree>
